input.quote: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
input.rationale: § 13.1 is the operative Services licence grant and fails the fallback on two material terms: it expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors with no path to add them (walk-away territory under the rule), and it is revocable at Vendor's sole discretion. § 13.2 cures neither point because it is limited to paid-up/embedded software and Vendor Technology, not the Services. § 13.3 helps on revocation (notice-and-cure only) and on transfer to an Affiliate or successor, but it addresses assignment of licence rights rather than day-to-day Affiliate and contractor use, and it directly conflicts with § 13.1's "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion". The redline makes the minimal edit to reach the preferred position by extending the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and tying revocation and transfer to the standard already agreed in § 13.3.

proposal.summary: Extend § 13.1 Services licence to Affiliates and contractors and remove revocability at Vendor's discretion
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Services licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and removed revocation at Vendor's sole discretion so that revocation follows the notice-and-cure standard already agreed in § 13.3. This aligns § 13.1 with §§ 13.2-13.3 and our playbook position that the licence cover Affiliates and contractors and not be revocable at will.

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a licence, revocable or suspendable only as permitted by Section 13.3 and transferable as permitted by Section 13.3, to use the Services.
